components.css: .ds-wrap{overflow-x:auto;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce3ed;border-radius:12px}.ds-table{font-family:"Segoe UI",sans-serif;width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.91rem}.ds-table th{text-align:left;background:#edf1f7;color:#4c5e75;font-size:.79rem;padding:.85rem 1.1rem}.ds-table td{padding:.75rem 1.1rem;border-top:1px solid #e6ecf3}.ds-table tr:hover{background:#f2f6fe}.ds-table a{color:#1d4bb2;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}.ds-table a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-table a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2563eb;outline-offset:3px}.ds-table small{display:block;color:#526277;margin-top:.3rem}.ds-location{overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#435773}.ds-status{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;padding:.3rem .6rem;border-radius:5px;color:#17613c;background:#e7f4ed}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-table thead{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)}.ds-table tbody tr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;padding:.4rem .5rem}.ds-table td{border:0;padding:.55rem .5rem}.ds-location{grid-column:1;grid-row:2}.ds-kind{grid-column:2;grid-row:1}.ds-state{grid-column:2;grid-row:2}}

narrative.overview: Staff can scan record names and locations, navigate the collection, and reach editing actions in a familiar workspace. The interface uses a navy navigation rail, a cool canvas, white work surfaces, blue actions and compact labels. Native controls and readable record details support desktop use and phone scans.
keyCharacteristics: Navigation remains distinct from the main work area.
Inventory names and parent locations lead the reading order.
A restrained palette carries action, hierarchy and culture status.
dos: Do keep record names, parent locations and culture status easy to scan.
Do use native controls and preserve visible keyboard focus.
Do retain readable labels and wrapping locations on narrow screens.
donts: Don't rely on color alone to convey culture status.
Don't truncate navigation labels or long locations when they can wrap.
Don't add decorative raster assets to the inventory workspace without a product need.
